name: Bandaram Pharma Packtech Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2022, Bandaram Pharma 
Packtech Ltd manufactures products related 
to paper, packaging material, pharma, food and beverages, etc.
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company supplies various categories of 
recycled paper, both imported and indigenous, to small and medium-sized paper mills, located mainly in the East & West Godavari Districts of Andhra Pradesh.

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
cons: Stock is trading at 3.26 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -12.4%
Company has a low return on equity of 8.26% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Company has high debtors of 185 days.
